prompt.zh-TW: 暖木家具辦理現金增資，發行 {{number:vars.shares}} 股新股，每股面額 {{money:vars.par}}，發行價格 {{money:vars.price}}。收到的現金在股東權益裡要怎麼記？
prompt.en: Warm Timber Furniture issues {{number:vars.shares}} new shares for cash at {{money:vars.price}} each; the par value is {{money:vars.par}} per share. How is the cash received recorded within equity?

text.zh-TW: 面額的部分記股本，超過面額的部分記資本公積（股本溢價）
text.en: The par value goes to share capital and the amount above par to capital surplus (share premium)

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。股本只記面額乘以股數；股東多付的部分是另一種投入，放在資本公積。
feedback.en: That is right. Share capital records only par value times the number of shares; what shareholders pay above that is a separate contribution, recorded in capital surplus.

text.zh-TW: 全部記股本，因為都是股東付進來的錢
text.en: All of it goes to share capital, since it is all money paid in by shareholders

feedback.zh-TW: 你看出這些都是股東投入、不是賺來的，這點正確。不過股本這個科目只記面額，超過面額的部分要分開記成資本公積，報表才看得出溢價有多少。
feedback.en: You are right that all of it is contributed by shareholders rather than earned. But the share capital account records par value only; the excess is kept separately as capital surplus so the statements show the size of the premium.

text.zh-TW: 超過面額的部分是公司賺到的，記本期淨利
text.en: The amount above par is a gain for the company and goes to profit for the period

feedback.zh-TW: 你注意到公司收到的比面額多，觀察沒錯。但和自己的股東之間的出資往來不是營業活動，不會產生利益；它是股東權益的投入，不經過損益表。
feedback.en: You noticed the company receives more than par, which is correct. But contributions from its own shareholders are not trading; they create no profit and go straight to equity without passing through the income statement.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_a1b2}}是正確的拆法：股本放面額，資本公積放溢價。{{option:o_c3d4}}把溢價混進股本；{{option:o_e5f6}}把股東出資當成利益。
explanation.en: {{option:o_a1b2}} is the correct split: par value in share capital, the premium in capital surplus. {{option:o_c3d4}} mixes the premium into share capital; {{option:o_e5f6}} treats a shareholder contribution as profit.
